import {useLayoutEffect,useRef,useState} from "react";
import {bindMotionParameters,layoutSelection} from "../lib/motion";
import {useMotionHostRef} from "../lib/motion-ref";
import {createMotionTransaction} from "../lib/motion-transaction";
import {useCadenceMotion} from "../lib/provider";
import {createSelectionProjection} from "../lib/selection-projection";

export function Fixture({changed=false,stale=false}) {
  const {node,ref}=useMotionHostRef();
  const cm=useCadenceMotion(node);
  const [transaction]=useState(createMotionTransaction);
  const controller=useRef();
  useLayoutEffect(()=>{controller.current=createSelectionProjection(node,transaction);return()=>controller.current.dispose()},[node,transaction]);
  useLayoutEffect(()=>{
    const projection=controller.current;
    const p=cm.parameters(bindMotionParameters(layoutSelection,"layout.shared/selection"));
    const revision=transaction.revision("state",changed);
    if(stale)transaction.revision("state",!changed);
    projection.commit(revision,{x:changed?80:0,y:0,width:40,height:20},p.transition,cm.reduced);
  });
  return <span ref={ref} data-slot="fixture" data-motion={cm.mode} aria-selected={changed}>Persistent indicator</span>;
}
